name: TS3003c
method: keypoints = AMI abstractive annotation (decisions, actions, problems, abstract sentences) mapped to keyword groups and spans by Claude (Opus); questions written by Claude from the gold transcript

keypoints.text: The marketing expert presented the results of trend-watching reports, which indicated that there is a need for products which are fancy, innovative, and easy to use.
The trend-watching reports indicated a need for dark colors, recognizable shapes, and a familiar material like wood.
The user interface designer discussed the option to include speech recognition and which functions to include on the remote.
The industrial designer discussed which options he preferred for the remote in terms of energy sources, casing, case supplements, buttons, and chips.
The remote will have a docking station.
The remote will use a conventional battery and a docking station which recharges the battery.
The remote will use an advanced chip.
The remote will have changeable case covers.
The case covers will be available in wood or plastic.
The case will be single curved.
Whether to use kinetic energy or a conventional battery with a docking station which recharges the remote.
Whether to implement an LCD screen on the remote.
Choosing between an LCD screen or speech recognition.
The team members will look at the corporate website.
The user interface designer will continue with what he has been working on.
The industrial designer and user interface designer will work together.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, what age group of customers is the remote targeted at?
In the remote control conceptual design meeting, to which cities did the marketing expert send trend-watchers?
In the remote control conceptual design meeting, which two editions did the marketing expert advise bringing out, and for whom?
questions.answer: A wood-like edition for more exclusive, wealthier people and a grey-black edition for people with less means.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how would the proposed single subtitle button work?
questions.answer: One push gives small subtitles, a double push gives big subtitles for people who can't read small ones.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how long did the interface designer think one battery would last?
questions.answer: Six months or more, since the small display uses little energy.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, why did the marketing expert advise against speech recognition, and where did he suggest putting it instead?
questions.answer: The survey showed the target group would not pay more for it; it would be better in the other product meant for younger people.

questions.q: In the remote control conceptual design meeting, how did the project manager propose that users find a lost remote?
questions.answer: A button on the docking station that makes the remote start beeping, which is cheaper than voice recognition.
